title: Designing physically separated bimetallic catalysts through cooperative redox enhancement (CORE)
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00479E, Tutorial Review

Bohyeon Kim, Isaac T. Daniel, Mark Douthwaite, Samuel Pattisson, Richard J. Lewis, Ouardia Akdim, Steven McIntosh, Graham J. Hutchings
The recent discovery that nanoscale electrochemical coupling between catalyst particles leads to an increase in catalytic turnover suggests a new paradigm for understanding catalytic mechanisms, and the associated design of heterogeneous catalysts.
